peer_client_contract.path: A40DF0 reference -> A4C250 -> A4C030 -> A5DE34 -> A5E844; caller A40DF0 not re-expanded.
peer_client_contract.mode: A4C0EA pushes EBX=0 as first argument. A5DE34 forwards its mode unchanged. Observed Original E8/xrefs have one caller of each open/create entry, and no absolute pointer bytes to those entries.
peer_client_contract.owner: A4C030 allocates actual 2Ch endpoint, opens mode 0, establishes capacities/buffers and starts its worker before output publication. GameNativeOnlineProcess builds retained adapters/globals/runtime; it does not create an endpoint or peer.
peer_client_contract.failure: A negative open or subsequent creation failure retains the existing cleanup and _exit(0); no ignore-failure or offline fallback is added.

peer_name_contract.client_pid: A5E557 snapshots processes, identifies current PID, opens its parent with 400h query access, requires parent creation time strictly older, then publishes that parent PID; otherwise leaves output untouched and returns error.
peer_name_contract.server_pid: Any nonzero mode takes GetCurrentProcessId in A5E844. The branch exists in the Original and current Source; it is not restricted to numeric 1.
peer_name_contract.server_transport: CreateNamedPipeW(name, 40080003h, 6, 1, 400h, 400h, 5000, security); deny network SID, allow logon SID. Client opens existing overlapped duplex pipe and requests message read mode.
peer_name_contract.not_bootstrap: The helper creates a pipe/protocol transport owner. No observed title-specific caller selects server mode, owns a compatible request/reply loop, launches the game as its child or retains that service through the child lifetime.
peer_name_contract.protocol_admission_from_existing_Source: Current native_online_ipc.cpp encodes an 8-byte marker/counter request, advances counter/phase, and accepts only an 8-byte response with marker 8 and complemented response value equal to the current counter. Protocol framing/encoding, asynchronous exchange and timeout/cleanup behavior also apply. No server implementation is inferred from this client contract.
peer_name_contract.naming_provenance: XLive/BSP names are analyst hypotheses, not recovered vendor symbols; the generic helper and parent-PID shape do not establish a Microsoft GFWL server.

conclusions.explains_missing_peer_evidence: It supplies a concrete bypass of the very client-init call whose genuine parent/server producer remains unidentified. Therefore success of this modded Original runtime would not demonstrate that the unmodified client was serviced. The bypass does not identify a peer, prove one never existed, or establish which runtime an older observation used.
conclusions.Source_fidelity: Current reconstructed raw constructor explicitly calls initialize_native_online_ipc_slot_00a4c250 and factory opens mode0. Preserve that unmodified-Original contract; do not infer authorization to NOP/wire it from installed runtime behavior.
conclusions.genuine_runtime_limit: Using preserved SDK2.0.673.0 avoids this override fault and prior finite title smoke succeeds. That is not evidence the faithful raw constructor/IPC startup, menu, account, or gameplay passes.
conclusions.no_server_ownership_inference: XLive/BSP analyst names, DLL exports and parent-PID pipe naming do not establish Microsoft ownership or a compatible request/reply implementation.

next_evidence: For a faithful Original runtime claim, capture exact Original EXE and runtime DLL identities plus pre/post bytes at A40F5E and8F841F, and actual client/server activity; a modded Original observation cannot substitute.

To admit the genuine client path, identify and preserve the real parent process bootstrap and matching protocol service, or obtain authoritative unmodified runtime evidence explaining its absence. Do not substitute a dummy server or silently skip the initializer.

If a separately scoped installed-override compatibility mode is requested, document both writes, slot/lifetime effects and image-layout assumptions explicitly before implementation; this audit does not implement or validate such a mode.
